description: Na₅Mn₃F₁₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with four MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-60°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.66 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-53°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.51 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.54 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.90 Å. There are three inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-33°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.14 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with four MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-46°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.08 Å. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-46°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.13 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Mn tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Mn atom.
